subject: POC workbench: hands-on session timing, load window, and sanitization plan
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@stellaris.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@stellaris.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff + hands-on session for Redwood POC

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Stellaris is excited to move to a short hands-on POC. We want to run a working session that includes: prompt review & tuning, routing tests for our two tenant domains, and a short load test (sim ~5k messages over 2 hours).

Questions before we lock dates:
- What are your typical windows for a load run (we're on PST)?
- Any specific sample payload formatting you prefer?
- Redaction guidance: we have PHI-like fields — what should we sanitize before upload vs. treat as tokenized examples?

Akira from our integration team (cc'd) will help with ingest. Can you propose 2 x 90-minute slots next week?

Thanks,
Tara
Senior Product Manager
Stellaris Health

Attachment: initial-poc-outline.pdf (1 page stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@stellaris.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Akira Yamamoto <akira@kanecloud.com>, ops@stellaris.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff + hands-on session for Redwood POC

Hi Tara — great to hear. Available windows next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-17 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-11-19 09:30–11:00

We can run the prompt review and routing tests in the first 60 minutes and a focused load window in the final 30–45 minutes. If you want the full 2-hour load, we can shift to a dedicated slot and bring extra capacity.

On sample payloads: a CSV with columns [id, prompt, metadata.routing_key, expected_label] works best. Dev will attach a sample template.

Redaction: we recommend removing direct identifiers (names, SSNs) and replacing with consistent tokens (e.g., <PATIENT_ID>). For PHI fields that are required for model behavior (dates, medication names), wrap them in tokens and list them in the metadata column so we can map them for evaluation. See our quick guide attached.

I'll hold both slots for now — please confirm which you prefer.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: sample_prompt_template.csv (stub), redaction_guidelines_v2.pdf (stub)

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara@stellaris.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff + hands-on session for Redwood POC

Tara, Jordan — attaching the CSV template and a short checklist we'll use during the session. A couple of practical notes:
- If you want to simulate tenant routing, include routing_key values: "east" and "west" (we'll map them to model variants).
- For the load segment: please provide 500–1,000 representative prompts in advance so we can stage and warm caches; we'll generate the larger test from them.
- File upload limit via secure share: 250MB. If you need larger, we can arrange a presigned S3 exchange.

I'll be on the session to manage the runtime config and batching thresholds.

Cheers,
Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_prompt_set_v1.csv (stub), workload-checklist.txt (stub)

From: Akira Yamamoto <akira@kanecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara@stellaris.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 03:11:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Kickoff + hands-on session for Redwood POC

Thanks — Stellaris will take Thu 2026-11-19 09:30–11:00 PST. That gives us time to prepare the redaction pipeline. Two clarifications:
1) We need the exact schema you expect for metadata.routing_key and a brief example mapping for model variants.
2) Are there any special headers or tokens Redwood needs for tenant isolation during the run?

I'll upload a sanitized sample set by Monday and confirm sizes.

— Akira
Integration Lead, KaneCloud (partner for Stellaris)

Quoted below is Jordan's earlier note for reference.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@stellaris.ai>, Akira Yamamoto <akira@kanecloud.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Final plan + redaction checklist + drive link

Thanks Akira — Thu 2026-11-19 09:30–11:00 PST is confirmed. Quick checklist and links below:

Pre-session (please complete by Wed 2026-11-18 17:00 PST):
- Upload sanitized sample_prompts.csv to shared Drive folder. Use column headers: id, prompt, metadata.routing_key, expected_output.
- For any fields you keep that could be sensitive, replace values with tokens like <PATIENT_ID> and add an explanation row in the metadata column.
- Indicate whether you want a short (30-minute) load window inside the session or a separate 2-hour soak.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSamplePOCdrive (folder contains: sample_prompt_template.csv, redaction_guidelines_v2.pdf)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-4571

Soojin will run the routing switch-over and monitor latency; Dev will handle batching and KV caching for the load window. I'll send the calendar invite with the tentative hold and an ics file.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: calendar-invite-POC.ics (invite stub)

From: Tara Singh <tara@stellaris.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Akira Yamamoto <akira@kanecloud.com>
Cc: ops@stellaris.ai, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final plan + redaction checklist + drive link

Perfect — confirmed. We'll upload: sample_prompts_sanitized.csv (approx 820 rows), and an explanatory mapping file (metadata_mapping.jsonl) by Tue EOD. We want the 30-minute in-session load window to validate latency and cost. If it looks good, we'll schedule a separate soak later.

One ask for the working session agenda: can we include a 15-minute block to review evaluation metrics you'll capture (latency P50/P95, token cost, and quality regression on expected_output)? If so, please include in the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Tara
Senior Product Manager, Stellaris Health
